text: Select: metabolism.met_id, metabolism.met_conversion, metabolism.pathway_key, compound_records.compound_name AS substrate_compound_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Source: metabolism, compound_records, compound_structures. Join: metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id AND compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Sort: None. Limit: 200.
